title: Google Uses AI to Fix Thousands of Chrome Vulnerabilities in a Month, Exceeding the Total of the Past Two Years

content_html:
Google's recent data is astonishing: with the help of AI tools, the team fixed as many as 1072 security vulnerabilities in just two versions, Chrome 149 and Chrome 150, released in June. By comparison, the total number of vulnerabilities fixed in 23 Chrome versions released over the past two years was only 1036 — AI has brought a qualitative change to the efficiency of vulnerability discovery and repair.

Gemini enters the scene, and vulnerability hunting enters the industrialized era

Doug Turner, Chrome Engineering Director, stated that large language models have fundamentally changed the economic landscape of cybersecurity, transforming vulnerability discovery into an automated and industrialized operation. By applying models like Gemini, Google has been able to fix vulnerabilities in advance, staying ahead of its opponents in the cybersecurity battle.

This trend is becoming an industry consensus. Microsoft announced earlier this month that it fixed a record number of 570 security vulnerabilities in its monthly updates and directly attributed the achievement to the support of AI tools. Apple, however, has not seen similar explosive growth; independent statistics show that the number of vulnerabilities fixed in 2026 is roughly the same as previous years.

When security researchers warned that AI would cause an exponential increase in vulnerability discovery, Google and Microsoft are proving with actual data that the defense side can also use AI to fight back. In this new normal where the speed of vulnerability discovery has increased tenfold or even a hundredfold, whoever can use AI to plug the gaps faster will seize the true initiative in this cyber warfare battle.

content_html_zh:
谷歌最近的数据令人震惊：在人工智能工具的帮助下，团队仅在 6 月份发布的 Chrome 149 和 Chrome 150 两个版本中就修复了多达 1072 个安全漏洞。 相比之下，近两年发布的23个Chrome版本中修复的漏洞总数仅为1036个——AI给漏洞发现和修复的效率带来了质的改变。

双子座登场，漏洞挖掘进入工业化时代

Chrome 工程总监 Doug Turner 表示，大型语言模型从根本上改变了网络安全的经济格局，将漏洞发现转变为自动化和工业化操作。 通过应用像 Gemini 这样的模型，谷歌能够提前修复漏洞，在网络安全之战中领先于对手。

这一趋势正在成为行业共识。 微软本月初宣布，在每月更新中修复了创纪录数量的 570 个安全漏洞，并将这一成绩直接归功于 AI 工具的支持。 然而，苹果公司却没有出现类似的爆炸性增长。独立统计数据显示，2026年修复的漏洞数量与往年大致持平。

当安全研究人员警告人工智能将导致漏洞发现呈指数级增长时，谷歌和微软正在用实际数据证明，防御方也可以利用人工智能进行反击。 在漏洞发现速度提升十倍甚至百倍的新常态下，谁能更快地利用人工智能填补漏洞，谁就能在这场网络战中掌握真正的主动权。
